title: Violin teacher Toad Johnson and studying until he ran away
summary: Howard says his father played all types of music; he studied violin with Toad Johnson until his first runaway at fourteen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Mr. Howard, sir, you were saying that you took your first lessons when you were seven years old on violin. Uh-huh. And that your father was a professional musician.
What kind of music did your father play?
All types, just like I did. All types? Yes, sir.
So how long did you study?
Oh, until I made my first runaway from home.
By the way, were you studying at school or with a private teacher?
No, no. I was a violin teacher. His name was Toad Johnson. Old man had whiskies. Yes, sir, what are you doing? Hey, is that thing insured?
Huh? I'll send you a picture. You'll find out.
No, you tell them in a few minutes, but they're going to tear all the pieces. Huh, huh, huh, huh.
